legacyPatterns.modernAlternative: REST API with ASP.NET Core Web API or gRPC
legacyPatterns.description: WCF is legacy technology not supported in .NET Core/.NET 6+. Service communication needs to be modernized to REST or gRPC.

legacyPatterns.modernAlternative: Azure Service Bus, Azure Queue Storage, or Azure Event Grid
legacyPatterns.description: MSMQ is Windows-specific and not cloud-native. Must be replaced with Azure messaging services for cloud deployment.

legacyPatterns.impact: Data loss on restart, not scalable
legacyPatterns.modernAlternative: Azure SQL Database, Azure Cosmos DB, or Azure Storage
legacyPatterns.description: Static in-memory repository pattern is not suitable for production or cloud deployment. Requires persistent database.

legacyPatterns.modernAlternative: Azure Cache for Redis or distributed session state
legacyPatterns.description: In-process session state doesn't work with load-balanced scenarios in cloud.
Migration from .NET Framework to .NET (Core) required for cross-platform, cloud-optimized deployment.
ASP.NET MVC 5 is legacy. Modernization to ASP.NET Core provides better performance and cloud support.

legacyPatterns.modernAlternative: Azure AD B2C, Microsoft Identity Platform
legacyPatterns.description: Application lacks authentication and authorization mechanisms needed for production deployment.
No logging or monitoring infrastructure for production observability.

blockers: WCF dependency - not supported in .NET Core
In-memory data storage - not persistent or scalable
readyAspects: Simple application architecture - easier to migrate
No complex database dependencies to migrate

factors: MSMQ to Azure Service Bus migration required (complex)

risks: WCF service contracts may have complex dependencies
MSMQ message processing logic needs careful migration
Session state migration may require application redesign
No existing tests to validate migration

phases.name: Foundation Setup
tasks: Create new .NET 8 ASP.NET Core project structure
Set up Azure resources (App Service, SQL Database, Service Bus)
Implement database schema and Entity Framework Core
Migrate data models and DTOs
Set up CI/CD pipeline with GitHub Actions

phases.name: Backend Modernization
tasks: Convert WCF service to ASP.NET Core Web API with REST endpoints
Implement repository pattern with Entity Framework Core
Replace MSMQ with Azure Service Bus
Implement order processing with Azure Functions or background service
Add structured logging with Application Insights

phases.name: Frontend Migration
tasks: Migrate ASP.NET MVC 5 views to ASP.NET Core MVC
Update Razor views syntax and tag helpers
Migrate bundling and minification to modern approach
Implement Azure Cache for Redis for distributed sessions
Update client-side JavaScript and AJAX calls

phases.name: Security and Production Readiness
tasks: Implement Azure AD B2C or Microsoft Identity authentication
Add authorization policies and role-based access
Implement security headers and HTTPS enforcement
Add health checks and monitoring
Performance testing and optimization
Security scanning and vulnerability assessment

phases.name: Testing and Deployment
tasks: Comprehensive integration testing
Load testing with Azure Load Testing
User acceptance testing
Production deployment to Azure App Service
Post-deployment monitoring and validation

targetArchitecture.database: Azure SQL Database or Azure Cosmos DB
targetArchitecture.backgroundProcessing: Azure Functions or Azure Container Apps
targetArchitecture.authentication: Azure AD B2C / Microsoft Identity Platform
targetArchitecture.networking: Azure Front Door or Application Gateway (optional)

required.purpose: Product catalog and order data storage
Replace MSMQ for order processing queue

recommended.purpose: Store product images and static files

totalEstimatedMonthlyCost.note: Costs vary based on usage, region, and selected SKUs

immediate: Begin with setting up Azure SQL Database and migrating data layer
Create new .NET 8 project structure following modern patterns
Replace WCF with REST API as highest priority (blocking for cloud)
Implement basic authentication before cloud deployment
shortTerm: Migrate MSMQ to Azure Service Bus
longTerm: Consider microservices architecture for better scalability
Implement event-driven architecture with Azure Event Grid
Add API Gateway (Azure API Management) for API governance
Consider containerization with Azure Kubernetes Service for advanced scenarios

risks.mitigation: Create comprehensive test suite during migration

risks.risk: WCF contracts may have hidden dependencies
risks.mitigation: Thoroughly analyze WCF service contracts and create equivalent REST API

risks.risk: In-memory data will be lost during migration
risks.mitigation: Use seed data or export current data structure to database

risks.risk: Session state changes may affect user experience
risks.mitigation: Implement distributed session carefully and test thoroughly
Provide team training on Azure PaaS services and .NET Core

summary.recommendedApproach: Replatform to .NET 8 with Azure PaaS services
keyBenefits: Cross-platform support and better performance with .NET 8
Better monitoring and diagnostics with Application Insights
summary.criticalPath: WCF → REST API migration and MSMQ → Azure Service Bus are the most critical items blocking cloud deployment
